title: Grateful Dead Live at Saratoga Performing Arts Center on 1983-06-18
source: Set 2 Only; Original Recording By Jeff Silberman; Sennheiser 441 (Front Row Balcony) > PCM > Dat >?; DAT Transfer Info: Friend's Dat (2 Hour) > (Possibaly 1 PCM) > (Unknown Cassette Deck) > Tape TDK MA 110; Transfer Information: Nakamichi MR-1 > Korg MR-1000 @ 1Bit/5.6 MHz; Tracking/Sample Rate Conversion With AudioGate Software To 32/96 Wave; Dithered/Flacked With Korg Aqua To 16/44; SBE's Checked/Fixed With Trader's Little Helper; Metadata Tagging With Tag&Rename

ai_review.summary: Good audience‑sourced tape with clear range and a smoking Scarlet Begonias jam.
ai_review.review: The recording captures the show with respectable clarity – the source has a wider frequency range than many later Beyer transfers, though it isn’t a pristine soundboard. Musically the concert shines, especially the extended jam in Scarlet Begonias that builds and rolls back again, and the second set maintains high energy throughout. Crowd ambience adds excitement without overwhelming the mix.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently strong 3‑4 star reviews praise both performance (notably Scarlet Begonias) and sound quality; minor technical limits keep the rating just above a solid four.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear overall sound with good range, some vintage tape coloration; crowd noise is present but adds energy rather than masking instruments.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Short but punchy first set that launches the band, followed by a second set that sustains momentum and showcases an especially tight Scarlet jam.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia delivers powerful guitar breaks, including a climactic lead that 'smokes'.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil's bass is described as being 'everywhere', driving the jams.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent (keyboard) wails on organ and adds memorable riffs at the start of Scarlet Begonias.
